shared_or_similar_visual_information: An arrowhead attached to a line
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It is a parallelism marker: the right slanted side belongs to the same parallel group as the left slanted side bearing the matching single arrowhead. Right image: It indicates the positive y direction and the direction in which the coordinate axis continues.
Rationales: Both images contain arrowheads on lines, but one marks a parallel relationship between sides and the other indicates a coordinate direction.
